description_en: A cylinder with a center through hole
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
outer_radius = 25   # 外径 (mm)
inner_diameter = 20  # 内孔直径 (mm)
height = 50         # 高度 (mm)

# === 建模 ===
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(height, outer_radius)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(inner_diameter)
)

show_object(result)
